preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 100000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n - 1 and all(1 <= p[i] < i + 2 for i in range(n - 1))
preconditions.description: The list of parents must have length n-1 and each parent must be a valid vertex index.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of distinct colorings modulo 1000000007.
